title: ½ Crown - Elizabeth II (1st portrait; without 'BRITT:OMN')

obverse.description:
Young laureate bust of Queen Elizabeth II right, legend around.

Note: no 'BRITT:OMN'
obverse.lettering_translation: Elizabeth II by the Grace of God Queen

reverse.description: Crowned quartered shield of arms flanked by E and R, legend above, denomination and date below.
reverse.lettering:

reverse.lettering_translation:
Defender of the Faith
Queen Elizabeth

comments:
House of Windsor (1917 to date), Elizabeth II (1952-2022), Pre-decimal issues (1953-70).

The standard weight of these coins was 5/11 troy ounce (218.2 grains). Under the Coinage Act of 1946, the composition changed from .500 silver to .750 copper/.250 nickel but the weight remained unchanged.

1962 obverse and reverse die varieties:
Obverse 3 I of GRATIA between beads, plain eyebrow, I of DEI to the left of a bead;
Obverse 4 I of GRATIA at a bead, incuse eyebrow, I of DEI between beads;
Reverse C D of DEF at a bead, medium rim, left leg of N in CROWN at a bead, gap between beads, small beads, cross after date between beads, rightmost bead on crown partially obscured, left leg of A of HALF between beads;
Reverse D D of DEF between beads, thin rim, left leg of N in CROWN between beads, small gap between beads, larger beads, cross after date at a bead, rightmost bead on crown clear, left leg of A of HALF to the left of a bead;

Image above is reproduced with kind permission of Declan Magee and Numista member Sjoelund.

The 1970-dated proof strikes were issued as part of the 'Last Sterling' mint set which comprised
half crown to halfpenny and were produced over the course of several years:
01/04/71-31/03/72 = 69,763
01/04/72-31/03/73 = 586,554
01/04/73-31/03/74 = 74,293
01/04/74-31/03/75 = 19,814
